name: Tensor Mask
summary: Creates a binary mask by thresholding the FA image of a tensor dataset between lower and upper bounds with DIPY 1.1.1 dipy_mask.
description: Wraps the DIPY 1.1.1 dipy_mask workflow: voxels of the FA image whose values lie between lb and ub become 1, all others 0. Use it to build a white matter or brain mask from FA, for example as a seed or stopping mask for tractography. Only the FA file of the tensor input is used.

inputs.description: Tensor dataset; only its FA image is thresholded.

outputs.description: Binary mask (mask.nii.gz) in the space of the FA image.

citations.text: Garyfallidis E, et al. Dipy, a library for the analysis of diffusion MRI data. Front Neuroinform 8:8 (2014).
Avesani P, et al. The open diffusion data derivatives, brain data upcycling via integrated publishing of derivatives and reproducible open cloud services. Sci Data 6:69 (2019).
